text:
anya: heads-up — customer Vertigo Labs (ticket TL-4321) reports function-calling behavior changed after yesterday's canary. Previously `build_invoice` was invoked with a nested `contact` kwarg; now the `contact` arg is missing from the tool call.

anya: pasted minimal customer request they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "prompt": "...invoice for order 123...",
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "build_invoice",
      "args": {
        "order_id": "123",
        "contact": {"email": "ops@vertigo.com"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

anya: customer expectation (what their app sees): `build_invoice(order_id='123', contact={'email': 'ops@vertigo.com'})`
anya: what their logs show after canary: `build_invoice(order_id='123')` — contact omitted. in ~10% of their calls it also appears the tool call is not emitted at all.

samir: which model/variant + rollout id? streaming or non-streaming?

anya: variant `v2-quant`, rollout id `r-20260218-ctxopt`, rolled at 2026-02-18T22:13Z. streaming=false. sample request id from customer: `req_0b9f2a`.

ingrid: @samir can you check routing logs and marshaller/args-sanitizer paths. also did we change any tool-call schema transforms in the quant pipeline? :eyes:

samir: quick grep of infra logs for req_0b9f2a (attached):
```text
2026-02-18T22:13:02 router: routed -> v2-quant (node: gpu-12)
2026-02-18T22:13:02 serve: marshaller: apply schema-shim ordering=positional-first
2026-02-18T22:13:02 tool-runner: args-sanitizer: dropped key 'contact' (reason=unsupported-nested-dict)
```

samir: that `unsupported-nested-dict` flag came from the sanitizer introduced in PR #1110 for quant kernels to unify arg shapes. looks suspicious.

anya: i tried to repro locally using the customer's prompt against v2-quant; i can reproduce: build_invoice invoked without contact. curl i used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"v2-quant","prompt":"...invoice for order 123...","tools":[{"name":"build_invoice","args":{"order_id":"123","contact":{"email":"ops@vertigo.com"}}}]}'
```
response shows tool call missing contact.

samir: ok i'm initiating rollback of rollout r-20260218-ctxopt to restore `v1-stable` and will watch for customer confirmation.

deployer-bot: deployer: rollout r-20260218-ctxopt rolled back to `v1-stable` at 2026-02-18T22:16Z by samir (action: rollback).

anya: vertigo support just confirmed at 22:20Z that their job runs are back to normal. :heart:

samir: root cause preliminary: args-sanitizer component that we added to handle kwarg->positional conversions for quantized kernels was incorrectly treating nested dicts as unsupported and stripped them. creating PR to revert sanitizer and add a targeted fix. PR #1129 opened (revert part + unit test).

ingrid: filed follow-up ticket INF-738 (monitor + postmortem). assign samir + eng-ml for root cause + test coverage. also add an alert for toolcall-arg-drop rate >0.5% vs baseline.

anya: i'll follow up with customer thread and include mitigation notes. marking customer escalated -> resolved for now; keeping issue open for postmortem and release notes.

samir: will also add an integration test for nested-kwargs in tool calls and a canary gate to catch arg-drop regressions before rollout.

anya: thanks all.
